productFrame.purpose: Prepare the smallest existing-owner native qualification lane for later Root selection; strict author-family independence remains unchanged.

scope: Frozen F6 plus selected installed public Gemini CLI 0.42.0 source. Native closed_prompt_proof qualification only; no full native coding parity.
conclusion: Gemini CLI 0.42.0 supplies headless input, real generation-config schema plumbing, JSONL tool/result witnesses and policy enforcement primitives. F6 does not connect them to an eligible native Gemini qualification actor. A bounded existing-owner adapter cone is identifiable, but literal prompt preprocessing, effective configuration custody and exact model/retry truth remain open. These are finite protocol joins, not evidence of a complete executable route or a new selected profile.

pins.lineConvention: 1-based newline-delimited source lines; public file short names resolve through publicInspectedFiles; ABI paths resolve under frozenOwners, never the moving checkout.

feasibilityMatrix.standing: supported public primitive; input fidelity remains conditional
facts: Non-TTY input/output or prompt selection enters headless mode. --model and --output-format stream-json are supported. Stdin can carry the prompt without an argv-sized prompt. Supplying both -p and stdin concatenates them.
readStdin caps input at 8 MiB, warns and truncates; its initial no-input timer is 500 ms. Neither truncation nor prompt duplication may be silently treated as the exact request.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: A selected Gemini native contract must bind exact input bytes, finite input handling and effective configuration. No command or profile is selected here.

feasibilityMatrix.relation: Literal closed prompt without undeclared reads
feasibilityMatrix.standing: unresolved protocol closure; concrete counterexample in public source
facts: Headless processing interprets slash commands and @ references before sending the query. It emits the original input as the user message, not necessarily the processed model input.

readLocalFiles constructs ReadManyFilesTool directly and invokes it; it does not obtain that reader through the registered-tool selection. Empty coreTools and model tool denial alone therefore do not close this preprocessing path.
Resolved @ resources/files and enabled hooks can add content. The public user-message echo and zero model tool_use events are insufficient proof of literal prompt fidelity.
feasibilityMatrix.abiOwner: validator/qualification.ts:726-749 embeds arbitrary quoted source data; abg/worker_transport.ts:800-808 binds the original prompt/environment
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: The bounded adapter must resolve literal-input/preprocessing behavior for the actual closed qualification prompt and bind the effective context/settings. No supported universal literal-input switch was established in this pass; do not assume quoting JSON source text disables @ interpretation.

feasibilityMatrix.relation: Structured model response against the existing raw contract
feasibilityMatrix.standing: static settings-to-provider path present; provider compatibility unproved
facts: --output-format json/stream-json formats the CLI output envelope. There is no --json-schema option in the strict main CLI parser.

modelConfigs.customOverrides can carry modelConfig.generateContentConfig; resolution deeply merges it and the main chat request passes the resulting config to generateContentStream. The public SDK maps responseMimeType and responseJsonSchema.

A settings override matching an exactly selected model can thus carry application/json plus the existing request.responseJsonSchema. This is a static path, not a demonstrated successful schema-constrained provider response.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: Bind the complete derived settings/schema bytes and verify the exact provider/model/auth path accepts the schema. Retain the existing ABI raw-contract validator; no JSON envelope or schema request creates a Judgment.

feasibilityMatrix.standing: enforcement primitives present; effective configuration must be bounded
facts: --allowed-tools grants confirmation bypass, not a no-tools allowlist. Plan mode still permits read-only tools. Neither is the required closed lane.

Explicit empty tools.core removes built-in registration; discovery can still supply tools. The policy engine evaluates deny rules before model-requested tool invocation and can exclude denied tools from active declarations.

User exclusions have priority 4.4; administrator policy is tier 5. A user policy file does not supersede every ambient administrator rule. MCP, extensions, discovery and before-tool hooks also need a bounded effective selection.
The direct @ preprocessing path in G02 remains separate even if registered model tools are absent.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: Select and retain a complete effective no-tools configuration/policy under existing transport custody, including precedence and disabled/bounded hook/discovery surfaces. A pathname alone is not a digest of loaded policy/configuration.

feasibilityMatrix.relation: Truthful tool-use witness and result correlation
feasibilityMatrix.standing: supported event protocol; ABI parser absent
facts: JSONL tool_use carries tool_name, tool_id and parameters before scheduled execution. tool_result carries the same tool_id, success/error and optional result/error fields.
The witness must count attempted requests, including denied requests. stats.tool_calls alone is not sufficient, nor does it cover G02 preprocessing.
The CLI has legacy and experimental AgentSession branches; both emit the central tool events. A finite adapter should pin the branch/configuration it supports.
feasibilityMatrix.abiOwner: abg/worker_transport.ts:579-592 currently assigns plain text zero tool calls/retries without observation; implementation/qualification.ts:55 requires zero tool calls
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: A Gemini JSONL normalizer must provide the existing canonical tool count/invocation observations and reject tool attempts in closed_prompt_proof. Do not reuse the present plain_text zero as evidence.

feasibilityMatrix.relation: Exact final output, completion and errors
feasibilityMatrix.standing: supported event primitives; normalization must account for concrete negative cases
facts: Assistant message.content deltas carry answer text; the terminal result normally carries status/stats, not the answer. Concatenate only assistant deltas in order; user echoes and tool results are not the raw assessment.
Fatal errors/cancellation/max-turn handling can emit error information and nonzero exits. InvalidStream can emit an error and terminal error while the main path subsequently exits success.
Some stop paths emit terminal success without establishing a complete assessment. A last success or exit 0 is therefore insufficient. An exact admitted raw result remains the existing semantic owner.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: Normalize framing, result-bearing text, terminal/error facts and completeness into existing validation. Preserve the current nativeResultDisposition rule rather than inventing a blanket exit/retry policy; malformed/truncated/conflicting streams cannot fabricate success.

feasibilityMatrix.relation: Configured actor identity, model resolution and retry truth
feasibilityMatrix.standing: configured primitive present; exact effective selection and retry observation unresolved
facts: init.model is config.getModel(): configured selection, not remote attestation. CLI/environment/settings, alias overrides, model resolution, hooks and fallback can affect the actual request.
Automatic fallback can change the active model. retryWithBackoff emits internal RetryAttempt events; a complete retry counter is not established by the six public JSONL event kinds.
Final per-model statistics can use response.modelVersion or requested model. They are useful evidence, but not by themselves an exact call identity or a proof that no fallback/subcall occurred.
Gemini CLI modelDefinitions.family is not the Product-owned STDO profile-to-family correspondence. No family/model is inferred or selected here.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: Extend the existing exact configured-selection grammar only for a later explicitly selected model/profile and bound effective configuration. Preserve unknown when aliases/fallback/retry cannot be determined. No fabricated zero retry count or external attestation claim.

feasibilityMatrix.standing: existing ABI owners reusable; Gemini route not connected
facts: Use the existing owned process, timeout/termination, transport binding, CCall and raw-result admission chain. CLI result success is not process-group cleanup or native qualification proof.
F6 actor_process selects Claude unconditionally; its governed-context path explicitly requires Claude stream-json. The generic Gemini transport is not a native qualification actor.
The closed qualification request can be targeted without claiming Gemini native editing, native_workspace_work tool-result parity or governed-context protocol support.
feasibilityMatrix.missingJoin: Connect only the selected qualification assessment to the existing transport and pre-paid eligibility owner, then preserve actual P/J lineage. The current two-profile publication and QR02 attribution limits remain separate prerequisites.

laterDiscriminators.discriminator: Finite parser/input fixtures: arbitrary quoted @ and slash-like source data, exact prompt bytes, 8 MiB boundary and truncation, no prompt duplication; malformed/truncated/duplicate/conflicting JSONL; assistant-only reconstruction; denied tool requests count as attempts.

Public configuration/plan fixtures: exact effective settings and policy precedence, hook/discovery/MCP/extension closure, referenced-byte custody, exact model resolution and unknown identity/retry behavior; process completion/liveness observations use existing owners.

One later Root-authorized real eligible native closed_prompt_proof positive with the exact selected profile/configuration/schema and unchanged raw Judgment/provenance owners. Preserve actual CCall, actor invocation, transport binding, source and result evidence.

Nearest real negative: requested forbidden tool is unavailable/denied without effects; any observed tool request makes the closed assessment fail. Include the actual source-data preprocessing case rather than relying solely on stats.tool_calls.

Exact model/schema/error behavior: configured versus actually resolved model, unsupported schema/refusal/error and alias/fallback/retry behavior. Bound tests to the selected path; provider capability remains unknown until observed.

retainedLimits: No Gemini CLI execution, auth/config-home access, network/provider call, tests/builds, runtime event, source edit or moving D5 read occurred.
Only the two selected report files are written. The 72-file inventory is a source grant, not a claim that every file was exhaustively inspected.
No generic Gemini success, external review, token statistics, model prefix or CLI family metadata is native qualification/independence evidence.
Strict same-family default, published policy correspondence and prior-source unknowns remain unchanged. Any eligible future fixture must bind actual native source/provenance under existing owners.
No requirement to build a provider framework or implement native editing/governed-context parity follows from this report.
